march/app-ui#findNode.name: findNode
march/app-ui#findNode.signature: function findNode(L: DockTree, id: string): LayoutNode | null

march/app-ui#focusOnly.name: focusOnly
march/app-ui#focusOnly.doc: Focus mode: the panel's group stays open, every other group goes to a strip (the caller keeps the old layout).
march/app-ui#focusOnly.signature: function focusOnly(layout: DockTree, panel: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#focusOnly.tr: Odak kipi: panelin grubu açık kalır, öbür gruplar şeride iner.

march/app-ui#fromTree.name: fromTree
march/app-ui#fromTree.doc: A layout from a tree written without ids.

march/app-ui#groupOf.name: groupOf
march/app-ui#groupOf.signature: function groupOf(L: DockTree, panel: string): TabsNode | null

march/app-ui#groups.name: groups
march/app-ui#groups.doc: Every tab group, in tree order.

march/app-ui#hitTest.name: hitTest
march/app-ui#hitTest.doc: The drop target under the pointer while dragging, or null. The outer edge docks to the whole workspace.
march/app-ui#hitTest.signature: function hitTest(rects: Rects, x: number, y: number, opts: Partial<Metrics> = {}): Hit | null
march/app-ui#hitTest.tr: Sürüklerken imlecin altındaki bırakma hedefi: dış kenar, sekme başlığı ya da grubun beş bölgesi.

march/app-ui#isCollapsed.name: isCollapsed
march/app-ui#isCollapsed.doc: Collapsed: a group by its flag, a split when every child is.
march/app-ui#isCollapsed.tr: Düğüm kapalı mı: grup kendi bayrağıyla, ayrım bütün çocukları kapalıysa.

march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.name: LAYOUT_V
march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.doc: Version of the saved layout format (a saved layout of another version is ignored).
march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.tr: Kayıtlı düzen biçiminin sürümü; başka sürümdeki kayıt yok sayılır.

march/app-ui#maximize.name: maximize
march/app-ui#maximize.doc: Toggles a group filling the whole area.
march/app-ui#maximize.signature: function maximize(layout: DockTree, groupId: string): DockTree
march/app-ui#maximize.tr: Grubun tüm alanı kaplamasını açar ya da kapatır.

march/app-ui#METRICS.name: METRICS
march/app-ui#METRICS.doc: Pixel metrics: gap between areas, collapsed strip, group header, outer-edge hit band, outer inset.
march/app-ui#METRICS.value: Object.freeze({ gap: 6, strip: 28, header: 33, edge: 6, inset: 8 })
march/app-ui#METRICS.tr: Piksel ölçüleri: boşluk, şerit, başlık, dış kenar payı.

march/app-ui#movePanel.name: movePanel
march/app-ui#movePanel.doc: Moves a panel. target: a group id or ROOT; zone: a side or center; index: tab position (center).
march/app-ui#movePanel.signature: function movePanel(layout: DockTree, panel: string, target: string, zone: Zone, index?: number): DockTree
march/app-ui#movePanel.tr: Paneli taşır: bir grubun kenarına (yeni bölme), ortasına (sekme) ya da alanın kenarına.

march/app-ui#moveTab.name: moveTab
march/app-ui#moveTab.doc: Tab order: the panel moves to `index` in its group.
march/app-ui#moveTab.signature: function moveTab(layout: DockTree, panel: string, index: number): DockTree

march/app-ui#normalize.name: normalize
march/app-ui#normalize.doc: Drops empty groups and one-child splits, flattens nested splits of the same direction, weights sum to 1.
march/app-ui#normalize.tr: Boş grupları ve tek çocuklu ayrımları atar, aynı yöndeki iç içe ayrımları düzler.

march/app-ui#presetLayout.name: presetLayout
march/app-ui#presetLayout.doc: A layout from a preset tree, fitted to the panels at hand.
march/app-ui#presetLayout.signature: const presetLayout: (preset: Preset | undefined, defs: readonly PanelDef[]) => DockTree | null
march/app-ui#presetLayout.valueType: (preset: Preset | undefined, defs: readonly PanelDef[]) => DockTree | null
march/app-ui#presetLayout.tr: Hazır düzenden eldeki panellere uygun bir düzen kurar.

march/app-ui#resetPanel.name: resetPanel
march/app-ui#resetPanel.doc: A panel goes back to its default place (its own `place`).
march/app-ui#resetPanel.signature: function resetPanel(layout: DockTree, def: PanelDef, defs: readonly PanelDef[]): DockTree

march/app-ui#resizeSplit.name: resizeSplit
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.doc: Splitter: moves `delta` px between children a and b, minimums kept; the other neighbours do not move.
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.signature: function resizeSplit(layout: DockTree, splitId: string, a: number, b: number, delta: number, rects: Rects): DockTree
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.tr: Ayırıcı: iki komşu arasında piksel taşır, en küçük boyutları korur.

march/app-ui#restoreGroup.name: restoreGroup
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.doc: Opens a strip: the group gets its share (or its pixel size) back; `panel` comes to the front.
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.signature: function restoreGroup(layout: DockTree, groupId: string, panel?: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.tr: Şeritteki grubu açar; eski payına ya da saklanan boyutuna döner.

march/app-ui#restoreLayout.name: restoreLayout
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.doc: Reads a saved layout: null when broken or of another version; unknown and repeated panels drop, missing ones are added.
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.signature: function restoreLayout(raw: unknown, defs: readonly PanelDef[]): DockTree | null
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.tr: Kayıtlı düzeni okur: bozuksa boş döner, bilinmeyen paneller düşer, eksikler eklenir.

march/app-ui#reveal.name: reveal
march/app-ui#reveal.doc: Makes a panel visible: opens its strip, brings its tab to the front, ends another group's maximize.
march/app-ui#reveal.signature: function reveal(layout: DockTree, panel: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#reveal.tr: Paneli görünür yapar: şeridini açar, sekmesini öne alır.

march/app-ui#ROOT.name: ROOT
march/app-ui#ROOT.doc: The whole workspace as a drop target (docking to the outer edge).
march/app-ui#ROOT.tr: Bırakma hedefi olarak alanın tamamı (dış kenara yanaştırma).

march/app-ui#serialize.name: serialize
march/app-ui#serialize.tr: Düzeni düz JSON olarak verir (kaydetmek için).

march/app-ui#setActive.name: setActive
march/app-ui#setActive.doc: Brings a panel's tab to the front of its group.
march/app-ui#setActive.signature: function setActive(layout: DockTree, panel: string): DockTree

march/app-ui#singleLayout.name: singleLayout
march/app-ui#singleLayout.doc: Every panel in one tab group (the fallback with no preset).
march/app-ui#singleLayout.signature: const singleLayout: (defs: readonly PanelDef[], active?: string | null) => DockTree
march/app-ui#singleLayout.valueType: (defs: readonly PanelDef[], active?: string | null) => DockTree
march/app-ui#singleLayout.tr: Bütün panelleri tek sekme grubunda toplayan düzen.

march/app-ui#zoneRects.name: zoneRects
march/app-ui#zoneRects.doc: The five drop zones inside a group (the same bounds hitTest uses).
march/app-ui#zoneRects.signature: function zoneRects(r: Rect, header: number = METRICS.header): Record<Zone, Rect>

march/channel#channel.name: channel
march/channel#channel.doc: One channel: `const cartChanged = channel<{ count: number }>("cart.changed", { sticky: true })`.
march/channel#channel.signature: function channel<T = void>(name: string, options: ChannelOptions = {}): Channel<T>
march/channel#channel.tr: Tek bir kanal: `const cartChanged = channel<{ count: number }>("cart.changed", { sticky: true })`.

march/channel#channelDevtools.name: channelDevtools
march/channel#channelDevtools.doc: Dev tools: recent messages, live watch, channel table. On while DEV.enabled; `configure({ enabled, size })`.
march/channel#channelDevtools.signature: const channelDevtools: { traffic: () => readonly TrafficEntry[]; watch(fn: (e: TrafficEntry) => void): () => void; clear(): void; configure(o: { enabled?: boolean; size?: number; }): void; channels: () => { name: string; options: ChannelOptions; listeners: number; last: unknown; kept: unknown[]; }[]; wildcards: () => number; }
march/channel#channelDevtools.valueType: { traffic: () => readonly TrafficEntry[]; watch(fn: (e: TrafficEntry) => void): () => void; clear(): void; configure(o: { enabled?: boolean; size?: number; }): void; channels: () => { name: string; options: ChannelOptions; listeners: number; last: unknown; kept: unknown[]; }[]; wildcards: () => number; }
march/channel#channelDevtools.tr: Geliştirici araçları: son iletiler, canlı izleme, kanal tablosu. DEV.enabled iken açıktır; `configure({ enabled, size })`.

march/channel#channelScope.name: channelScope
march/channel#channelScope.doc: Start a channel scope in the current component: `scoped` channels used below it (and in it) get their own messages, listeners and sticky values, so two copies of a widget do not hear each other.
march/channel#channelScope.tr: Geçerli bileşende bir kanal kapsamı başlatır: altında (ve içinde) kullanılan `scoped` kanallar kendi iletilerine, dinleyicilerine ve kalıcı değerlerine sahip olur; böylece bir bileşenin iki kopyası birbirini duymaz.

march/channel#ChannelScope.name: ChannelScope
march/channel#ChannelScope.signature: function ChannelScope(props: { /** A name for the scope (shown in devtools; default "scope N"). @tr Kapsamın adı (devtools'ta gösterilir; varsayılan "scope N"). */ label?: string; /** Content, or a zero-arg function returning it, that uses the scope. @tr Kapsamı kullanan içerik ya da onu döndüren argümansız fonksiyon. */ children?: unknown; }): unknown

params.name: props
params.type: { /** A name for the scope (shown in devtools; default "scope N"). @tr Kapsamın adı (devtools'ta gösterilir; varsayılan "scope N"). */ label?: string; /** Content, or a zero-arg function returning it, that uses the scope. @tr Kapsamı kullanan içerik ya da onu döndüren argümansız fonksiyon. */ children?: unknown; }

props.name: label
props.doc: A name for the scope (shown in devtools; default "scope N").

props.doc: Content, or a zero-arg function returning it, that uses the scope.
props.tr: Kapsamı kullanan içerik ya da onu döndüren argümansız fonksiyon.

march/channel#defineChannels.name: defineChannels
march/channel#defineChannels.doc: Declare every channel of an app in one place (channels.ts). Names and payloads are checked at compile time.
march/channel#defineChannels.signature: function defineChannels<M extends Record<string, Spec<any>>>(spec: M): Channels<M>
march/channel#defineChannels.tr: Bir uygulamanın tüm kanallarını tek yerde tanımlar (channels.ts). Adlar ve yükler derleme zamanında denetlenir.

march/channel#of.name: of
march/channel#of.tr: defineChannels() için tek bir kanal tanımlar: `of<Payload>(options)`.

march/channel#onChannels.name: onChannels
march/channel#onChannels.doc: Wildcard listener on the current bus: "cart.*", "*" or an exact name. Untyped; prefer the group's `on`.
march/channel#onChannels.signature: function onChannels(pattern: string, fn: (m: Message) => void, opts?: ListenOptions): () => void
march/channel#onChannels.tr: Geçerli veri yolunda joker dinleyici: "cart.*", "*" veya tam ad. Türsüzdür; grubun `on` işlevi tercih edilmelidir.

march/channel#resetChannelTabs.name: resetChannelTabs
march/channel#resetChannelTabs.doc: Tests: forget the BroadcastChannel (a new global mock is picked up on next use).
march/channel#resetChannelTabs.tr: Testler için: BroadcastChannel'ı unutur (yeni bir genel sahte nesne sonraki kullanımda alınır).

march/channel#setChannelErrorHandler.name: setChannelErrorHandler
march/channel#setChannelErrorHandler.doc: Where listener errors go. A failing listener never stops the others. Without a handler the error goes to the listener's own error boundary (catchError / <Try>), else it is rethrown in a microtask. The errors module plugs in here.
march/channel#setChannelErrorHandler.tr: Dinleyici hatalarının gideceği yeri belirler. Hatalı bir dinleyici diğerlerini durdurmaz. İşleyici yoksa hata dinleyicinin kendi hata sınırına (catchError / <Try>) gider, o da yoksa mikro görevde yeniden fırlatılır.

march/channel#useChannel.name: useChannel
march/channel#useChannel.doc: Bind a scoped channel to the scope of the current component. Call it during setup and use the handle in event handlers and timers (they run without an owner and would otherwise reach the app-wide bus).
march/channel#useChannel.tr: Kapsamlı bir kanalı geçerli bileşenin kapsamına bağlar. Kurulum sırasında çağırın ve tutamacı olay işleyicilerinde ve zamanlayıcılarda kullanın (bunlar sahipsiz çalışır ve aksi halde uygulama genelindeki veri yoluna ulaşır).

march/behaviors/drag#arrowStep.name: arrowStep
march/behaviors/drag#arrowStep.doc: Arrow / Home / End / Page keys → a step (−1 … 1 per press, ×10 with Shift or Page keys); null for other keys.
march/behaviors/drag#arrowStep.signature: function arrowStep(e: KeyboardEvent, rtl: boolean = false): { dx: number; dy: number; home?: boolean; end?: boolean } | null

returns.type: { dx: number; dy: number; home?: boolean; end?: boolean } | null

march/behaviors/drag#arrowStep.tr: Ok / Home / End / Page tuşları → bir adım (basış başına −1 … 1, Shift veya Page tuşlarıyla ×10); diğer tuşlar için null.

march/behaviors/drag#draggable.name: draggable
march/behaviors/drag#draggable.doc: Make an element draggable: every press on it (or on `handle`) starts a pointerDrag session. Returns the cleanup. Works as an action: `<div use:draggable={[draggable, { handle: ".grip", onMove: (p) => … }]}>`.
march/behaviors/drag#draggable.signature: function draggable(el: Element, o: DraggableOptions = {}): () => void
march/behaviors/drag#draggable.tr: Bir öğeyi sürüklenebilir yapar: üzerine (veya `handle` üzerine) her basış bir pointerDrag oturumu başlatır. Temizleme işlevini döndürür. Eylem olarak çalışır: `<div use:draggable={[draggable, { handle: ".grip", onMove: (p) => … }]}>`.

march/behaviors/drag#track.name: track
march/behaviors/drag#track.doc: Track pointer drags that start on `el`. Returns the cleanup (also run with the current owner).
march/behaviors/drag#track.signature: function track(el: Element, o: TrackOptions): () => void
march/behaviors/drag#track.tr: `el` üzerinde başlayan imleç sürüklemelerini izler. Temizleme işlevini döndürür (geçerli sahiple de çalışır).

march/behaviors/roving-focus#rovingFocus.name: rovingFocus
march/behaviors/roving-focus#rovingFocus.doc: Arrow keys move among the items of `container`; only the active item is a Tab stop. Returns stop.
march/behaviors/roving-focus#rovingFocus.signature: function rovingFocus(container: HTMLElement, opts: RovingOptions = {}): () => void
march/behaviors/roving-focus#rovingFocus.tr: Ok tuşları `container` öğelerinin arasında gezinir; yalnızca etkin öğe Tab durağıdır. Durdurma işlevini döndürür.

march/behaviors/resize-handle#resizeHand.name: resizeHandle
march/behaviors/resize-handle#resizeHand.doc: Make `el` a resize separator. Returns the cleanup (also run with the current owner).
march/behaviors/resize-handle#resizeHand.signature: function resizeHandle(el: HTMLElement, o: ResizeHandleOptions): () => void
march/behaviors/resize-handle#resizeHand.tr: `el` öğesini yeniden boyutlandırma ayırıcısı yapar. Temizleme işlevini döndürür (geçerli sahiple de çalışır).

march/behaviors/list-nav#listNav.name: listNav
march/behaviors/list-nav#listNav.doc: Keyboard navigation over options shown by a field (aria-activedescendant pattern). Returns a keydown handler that returns true when it handled the key. Home / End need Ctrl / ⌘ (without it they move the caret in the field).
march/behaviors/list-nav#listNav.tr: Bir alanın gösterdiği seçenekler üzerinde klavye gezintisi (aria-activedescendant deseni). Tuşu işlediyse true döndüren bir keydown işleyicisi döndürür. Home / End için Ctrl / ⌘ gerekir (o olmadan imleci alanda hareket ettirirler).

march/behaviors/list-nav#moveCursor.name: moveCursor
march/behaviors/list-nav#moveCursor.doc: Next cursor index for a navigation key, or null when the key is not a navigation key. Clamped, never wraps.
march/behaviors/list-nav#moveCursor.tr: Bir gezinti tuşu için sonraki imleç dizini; tuş gezinti tuşu değilse null. Sınırlıdır, başa sarmaz.

march/behaviors/dropzone#dropzone.name: dropzone
march/behaviors/dropzone#dropzone.doc: Make `el` take dropped files. Returns the cleanup (also run with the current owner).
march/behaviors/dropzone#dropzone.signature: function dropzone(el: Element, o: DropzoneOptions): () => void
march/behaviors/dropzone#dropzone.tr: `el` öğesinin bırakılan dosyaları almasını sağlar. Temizleme işlevini döndürür (geçerli sahiple de çalışır).

march/behaviors/swipe#fling.name: fling
march/behaviors/swipe#fling.doc: Where a release at `pos` with velocity `v` (px / ms) would come to rest, capped (for snapping to the nearest point).
march/behaviors/swipe#fling.signature: function fling(pos: number, v: number, ms: number = 160, cap: number = 2): number
march/behaviors/swipe#fling.tr: `pos` konumunda `v` hızıyla (px / ms) bırakmanın duracağı yeri, sınırlı olarak hesaplar (en yakın noktaya oturtmak için).

march/behaviors/swipe#nearest.name: nearest
march/behaviors/swipe#nearest.doc: The resting point nearest to `target` among `points`.
march/behaviors/swipe#nearest.signature: const nearest: (points: readonly T[], target: number) => T
march/behaviors/swipe#nearest.valueType: <T extends number>(points: readonly T[], target: number) => T

march/behaviors/swipe#rubberBand.name: rubberBand
march/behaviors/swipe#rubberBand.doc: Resistance past a limit: `over` px of pull give `k·√over` px of travel (default 4·√over).
march/behaviors/swipe#rubberBand.signature: function rubberBand(over: number, k: number = 4): number
march/behaviors/swipe#rubberBand.tr: Sınırı aşınca direnç: `over` px çekme, `k·√over` px harekete karşılık gelir (varsayılan 4·√over).

march/behaviors/swipe#swipeable.name: swipeable
march/behaviors/swipe#swipeable.doc: Make `el` swipeable. Returns the cleanup. Works as an action: `<div use:swipeable={[swipeable, opts]}>`.
march/behaviors/swipe#swipeable.signature: function swipeable(el: Element, o: SwipeOptions = {}): () => void
march/behaviors/swipe#swipeable.tr: `el` öğesini kaydırılabilir yapar. Temizleme işlevini döndürür. Eylem olarak çalışır: `<div use:swipeable={[swipeable, opts]}>`.

march/behaviors/dismiss#dismiss.name: dismiss
march/behaviors/dismiss#dismiss.doc: Watch for presses outside `el` (and `inside`) and Escape. Returns stop (also run with the current owner).
march/behaviors/dismiss#dismiss.signature: function dismiss(el: Element | (() => Element | null | undefined) | null | undefined, o: DismissOptions): () => void

params.name: el
params.type: Element | (() => Element | null | undefined) | null | undefined

march/behaviors/dismiss#dismiss.tr: `el` (ve `inside`) dışındaki basışları ve Escape tuşunu izler. Durdurma işlevini döndürür (geçerli sahiple de çalışır).

march/i18n#dir.name: dir
march/i18n#dir.doc: Text direction of the active locale (signal).

march/i18n#format.name: format
march/i18n#format.doc: Format an ICU-style message with values. Apostrophes are literal (no ICU quoting: Turkish/English text uses them). Supports {x}, {n, plural, …} (with #, =N, offset-less), {s, select, …}, {n, number[, percent|integer|currency/XXX]}, {d, date[, short|medium|long]}, {d, time}.
march/i18n#format.signature: function format(msg: string, vals: Record<string, unknown>, loc: string = untrack(locale)): string
march/i18n#format.tr: ICU biçimli bir iletiyi değerlerle biçimlendirir. Kesme işaretleri olduğu gibidir (ICU tırnaklaması yok: Türkçe/İngilizce metinler bunları kullanır). {x}, {n, plural, …} (#, =N ile, offset yok), {s, select, …}, {n, number[, …} desteklenir.

march/i18n#loadLocale.name: loadLocale
march/i18n#loadLocale.doc: Register a lazy pack: loaded the first time `setLocale(loc)` is called.
march/i18n#loadLocale.signature: function loadLocale(loc: string, loader: () => Promise<{ default: Dict } | Dict>): void
march/i18n#loadLocale.tr: Tembel bir paket kaydeder: `setLocale(loc)` ilk çağrıldığında yüklenir.

march/i18n#removeMessages.name: removeMessages
march/i18n#removeMessages.doc: Take keys out of a locale's messages (their text falls back to the key); returns what was there, to put back with `messages(loc, removed)`.
march/i18n#removeMessages.signature: function removeMessages(loc: string, keys: Iterable<string>): Record<string, string>
march/i18n#removeMessages.tr: Bir dilin iletilerinden anahtarları çıkarır (metinleri anahtara düşer); çıkanları döndürür, messages(loc, çıkanlar) geri koyar.

march/i18n#tKey.name: tKey
march/i18n#tKey.doc: Key a tagged template produces (compiler and tests).
march/i18n#tKey.tr: Etiketli bir şablonun ürettiği anahtar (derleyici ve testler için).

march/i18n#typed.name: typed
march/i18n#typed.doc: Typed translator for a catalog: keys must exist and every variable must be passed.
march/i18n#typed.signature: function typed<M extends Record<string, string>>(): <K extends keyof M & string>(key: K, ...args: Args<M[K]>) => string

returns.type: <K extends keyof M & string>(key: K, ...args: Args<M[K]>) => string

march/i18n#typed.tr: Bir katalog için türlü çevirici: anahtarlar var olmalı ve her değişken verilmelidir.

march/i18n#unused.name: unused
march/i18n#unused.doc: Keys present in `loc` that no code looked up during this session (stale translations).
march/i18n#unused.signature: function unused(loc: string, used: Iterable<string>): string[]
march/i18n#unused.tr: `loc` içinde olup bu oturumda hiçbir kodun aramadığı anahtarlar (eskimiş çeviriler).

march/icons#defineIcon.name: defineIcon
march/icons#defineIcon.doc: Pure: unused icons are dropped from bundles (esbuild honours
march/icons#defineIcon.signature: const defineIcon: (name: string, d: readonly string[], fill?: boolean) => IconDef
march/icons#defineIcon.valueType: (name: string, d: readonly string[], fill?: boolean) => IconDef
march/icons#defineIcon.tr: Saf işlev: kullanılmayan simgeler paketlerden çıkarılır (esbuild @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ işaretini dikkate alır).

march/icons#Icon.name: Icon
march/icons#Icon.doc: `<Icon of={users} size="lg" />` — props may be live (`size={$size}`): the same <svg> repaints in place.

props.name: of
props.doc: The icon to draw (e.g. `users` from march/icons).

props.name: size
props.tr: "xs" 12px · "sm" 14px · "md" 16px (varsayılan) · "lg" 20px · "xl" 24px — ya da "em" ile yazı boyutunu alır.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative.
props.tr: Erişilebilir ad; verilmezse ikon süs amaçlı sayılır.

march/icons#isIconDef.name: isIconDef
march/icons#isIconDef.doc: Is the value an icon definition (defineIcon)?
march/icons#isIconDef.signature: function isIconDef(x: unknown): x is IconDef

march/icons#paintIcon.name: paintIcon
march/icons#paintIcon.doc: Draw an icon into an existing <svg> (attributes and shapes replaced): live icons repaint in place.
march/icons#paintIcon.signature: function paintIcon(svg: SVGSVGElement, def: IconDef, cls: string = "m-svg", label?: string): SVGSVGElement
march/icons#paintIcon.tr: Bir ikonu var olan <svg> içine çizer (öznitelik ve şekiller değişir): canlı ikonlar yerinde yeniden boyanır.

march/icons#svgIcon.name: svgIcon
march/icons#svgIcon.doc: Render an icon as an <svg> element. Decorative (aria-hidden) unless a label is given.
march/icons#svgIcon.signature: function svgIcon(def: IconDef, cls: string = "m-svg", label?: string): SVGSVGElement
march/icons#svgIcon.tr: Bir simgeyi <svg> öğesi olarak oluşturur. Etiket verilmedikçe süslemedir (aria-hidden).

march/icons/catalog#ICONS.name: ICONS
march/icons/catalog#ICONS.doc: Every built-in icon by name (for icon pickers and search; import single icons to keep bundles small).
march/icons/catalog#ICONS.tr: Tüm yerleşik simgeler ada göre (simge seçiciler ve arama için; paketleri küçük tutmak için tek tek simge içe aktarın).

march/icons/packs#Icon.name: Icon
march/icons/packs#Icon.doc: `<Icon name="lucide:user" size="lg" />` — <Icon> from march/icons plus `name`; props may be live.

props.name: of
props.doc: The icon to draw; `name` is used when it is not given.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative.
props.tr: Erişilebilir ad; verilmezse ikon süs amaçlı sayılır.

props.name: size
props.tr: "xs" 12px · "sm" 14px · "md" 16px (varsayılan) · "lg" 20px · "xl" 24px — ya da "em" ile yazı boyutunu alır.

march/icons/packs#Icon.tr: Ad ile ikon bileşeni ("lucide:user" gibi paket önekiyle); paket tembel yükleniyorsa geldiğinde çizilir.

march/icons/packs#icon.name: icon
march/icons/packs#icon.doc: Icon by name: "user" (March), "lucide:user", "tabler:chart-bar" — usable in any icon prop. Reactive: read in a component or effect, it updates when a lazily loaded pack arrives; until then (and for an unknown name) it is an icon without shapes. loadIcon() tells whether a name exists.
march/icons/packs#icon.tr: Ad ile ikon ("lucide:user" gibi paket önekiyle); önek yoksa March seti.

march/icons/packs#iconPack.name: iconPack
march/icons/packs#iconPack.doc: The pack with this id, if registered.

march/icons/packs#loadIcon.name: loadIcon
march/icons/packs#loadIcon.doc: Icon by name, waiting for a lazily loaded pack; undefined when the pack or the name does not exist.
march/icons/packs#loadIcon.tr: Ad ile ikon; tembel yüklenen paketi bekler. Paket ya da ad yoksa undefined.

march/icons/packs#packIcon.name: packIcon
march/icons/packs#packIcon.doc: Make a pack icon (frozen): `packIcon("arrow-left", ["M19 12H5", …], { sw: 2, rtl: true })`.
march/icons/packs#packIcon.signature: const packIcon: (name: string, d: readonly string[], more?: Omit<PackIconDef, "name" | "d" | "paint">) => PackIconDef
march/icons/packs#packIcon.valueType: (name: string, d: readonly string[], more?: Omit<PackIconDef, "name" | "d" | "paint">) => PackIconDef
march/icons/packs#packIcon.tr: Paket ikonu oluşturur (dondurulmuş): packIcon("arrow-left", ["M19 12H5", …], { sw: 2, rtl: true }).

march/icons/packs#packPaint.name: packPaint
march/icons/packs#packPaint.doc: The `paint` hook of every pack icon: grid, stroke width, RTL mirroring, even-odd fills.
march/icons/packs#packPaint.signature: function packPaint(svg: SVGSVGElement, def: IconDef): void
march/icons/packs#packPaint.tr: Her paket ikonunun paint kancası: ızgara, çizgi kalınlığı, RTL aynalama, çift-tek dolgu.

march/icons/packs#parseIconRef.name: parseIconRef
march/icons/packs#parseIconRef.doc: Split "lucide:user" → ["lucide", "user"]; no prefix → the March set.
march/icons/packs#parseIconRef.signature: function parseIconRef(ref: string): [pack: string, name: string]
march/icons/packs#parseIconRef.tr: "lucide:user" → ["lucide", "user"] olarak böler; önek yoksa March seti.

march/icons/packs#registerIconPack.name: registerIconPack
march/icons/packs#registerIconPack.doc: Add an icon set; icon("id:…") and <Icon name="id:…"> use it. Returns a function that removes it again.
march/icons/packs#registerIconPack.tr: İkon seti ekler; icon("id:…") ve <Icon name="id:…"> onu kullanır. Geri kaldıran bir işlev döndürür.

march/theme#aurora.name: aurora
march/theme#aurora.doc: Aurora — always dark: glass panels over a softly lit navy page, a glowing periwinkle edge, gradient buttons.
march/theme#aurora.tr: Aurora: her zaman koyu; hafif ışıklı lacivert sayfanın üstünde cam paneller, parlayan kenar, gradyan düğmeler.

march/theme#candy.name: candy
march/theme#candy.doc: Candy — playful pastel: gradient buttons, pill-like corners, a soft glow, thick icons.
march/theme#candy.tr: Şeker: eğlenceli pastel; gradyan düğmeler, hap gibi köşeler, hafif parıltı, kalın ikon.

march/theme#COLOR_TOKENS.name: COLOR_TOKENS
march/theme#COLOR_TOKENS.doc: Every colour token the components accept (theme tokens only, never a raw CSS colour).
march/theme#COLOR_TOKENS.tr: Bir bileşenin `color` prop'unun kabul ettiği renk belirteçleri (src/css/colors.css). Yalnızca tema belirteçleri, ham CSS rengi asla; böylece tema değişince her bileşen tutarlı kalır. defineTheme ile ad eklenebilir (marka / kategori renkleri).

march/theme#contrast.name: contrast
march/theme#contrast.doc: WCAG contrast ratio of two hex colors.
march/theme#contrast.signature: function contrast(a: string, b: string): number
march/theme#contrast.tr: İki hex rengin WCAG karşıtlık oranı.

march/theme#contrastTheme.name: contrastTheme
march/theme#contrastTheme.doc: High Contrast — accessibility: black, white, strong blue / yellow.
march/theme#contrastTheme.tr: Yüksek Karşıtlık: erişilebilirlik için siyah, beyaz, güçlü mavi / sarı.

march/theme#cream.name: cream
march/theme#cream.doc: Classic Cream — HADİ on a warm off-white; espresso in the dark.
march/theme#cream.tr: Klasik Krem: sıcak kırık beyaz üzerinde HADİ; koyu kipte espresso.

march/theme#defineTheme.name: defineTheme
march/theme#defineTheme.doc: Validate and freeze a theme definition.
march/theme#defineTheme.tr: Bir tema tanımını doğrular ve dondurur.

march/theme#ember.name: ember
march/theme#ember.doc: Ember — always dark: warm charcoal and orange, big round corners, raised cards, roomy spacing.
march/theme#ember.tr: Köz: her zaman koyu; sıcak kömür ve turuncu, büyük yuvarlak köşe, yükseltilmiş kartlar, ferah boşluk.

march/theme#ensureContrast.name: ensureContrast
march/theme#ensureContrast.doc: `fg` moved toward black or white (whichever the background needs) until it reaches `min` contrast on `bg`.
march/theme#ensureContrast.signature: function ensureContrast(fg: string, bg: string, min: number = 4.5): string
march/theme#ensureContrast.tr: `fg` rengini, `bg` üzerinde `min` karşıtlığa ulaşana dek siyaha veya beyaza (arka planın gerektirdiğine) doğru kaydırır.

march/theme#graphite.name: graphite
march/theme#graphite.doc: Graphite — neutral grey for desktop apps: small corners, compact spacing, thin icons.
march/theme#graphite.tr: Grafit: masaüstü uygulamaları için nötr gri; küçük köşe, sıkı boşluk, ince ikon.

march/theme#HADI.name: HADI
march/theme#HADI.doc: HADİ Sosyal's official colors (hadimobile lib/theme/hadi_colors.dart › HadiColors, HadiLight; night tones). The four brand colors and their HADİ names: orange = Heyecan, blue = Aktivite, green = Dostluk, purple = İletişim.
march/theme#HADI.signature: const HADI: { readonly orange: "#F2801F"; readonly blue: "#1D9AD6"; readonly green: "#78BE3A"; readonly purple: "#A3338C"; readonly pink: "#D33C73"; readonly gold: "#D9A93A"; readonly error: "#D24444"; readonly ink: "#17344F"; readonly ink2: "#3E5770"; readonly ink3: "#6B7F92"; readonly mist: "#F2F6F9"; readonly line: "#DCE4EB"; readonly night: "#0D2033"; readonly nightCard: "#152D45"; readonly nightLine: "#244460"; readonly nightText: "#E8EFF5"; readonly nightMuted: "#9DB0C2"; }
march/theme#HADI.valueType: { readonly orange: "#F2801F"; readonly blue: "#1D9AD6"; readonly green: "#78BE3A"; readonly purple: "#A3338C"; readonly pink: "#D33C73"; readonly gold: "#D9A93A"; readonly error: "#D24444"; readonly ink: "#17344F"; readonly ink2: "#3E5770"; readonly ink3: "#6B7F92"; readonly mist: "#F2F6F9"; readonly line: "#DCE4EB"; readonly night: "#0D2033"; readonly nightCard: "#152D45"; readonly nightLine: "#244460"; readonly nightText: "#E8EFF5"; readonly nightMuted: "#9DB0C2"; }
march/theme#HADI.tr: HADİ resmi renkleri, açık ve gece tonlarıyla: Heyecan (turuncu), Aktivite (mavi), Dostluk (yeşil), İletişim (mor).

march/theme#hadi.name: hadi
march/theme#hadi.doc: HADİ — the HADİ Sosyal brand (default): navy ink, the four-color ribbon, Figtree + Bricolage Grotesque.
march/theme#hadi.tr: HADİ: HADİ Sosyal markası (varsayılan): lacivert mürekkep, dört renkli şerit, Figtree + Bricolage Grotesque.
